I learned farming from my father and neighbors, and I never went to school. This bean plot is only 0.14 hectares and it is rented land, so I will not put fertilizer or improved seed into it — that money is better saved for my own plots. I will plant local bean seed I kept from last year, do the weeding and harvesting with my wife and children over about six days, and I will not hire anyone. I am not using chemicals or irrigation because the rains have always been enough for beans and those things cost too much cash.
